interpretation: Each retrieval workload-by-treatment cell has one observed answer; the panel is descriptive and supports no winner, confidence interval, statistical significance, or population claim.
All 16 retrieval cells failed the corrected scorer. The most frequent failures concern attribution and uncertainty; per-cell missing facts and field mismatches are retained.
All four maintenance sequences failed. Each made an unauthorized synthetic save attempt and presented no readable staged compaction candidate; no compaction was approved or promoted.

Maintenance A preparation already contained a behavioral failure. Only its incomplete same-session continuation was resumed after a confirmed unsupported CLI flag prevented the original continuation from starting; the original result remains unchanged and failed.
A total duration is unavailable for maintenance A because the recovery runner did not persist elapsed time. Its original attempt duration is retained separately; no replacement estimate is claimed.
Read bytes and actual CLI-reported token values are retained per trial. Cached input is a subset of input and is not added a second time. Missing phase telemetry stays unavailable.
Prior 2026-10-19 U8 samples remain historical and are linked for context; they are excluded from every count and comparison here.
Synthetic results do not establish live Library behavior, provider publication/recovery behavior, enforced isolation, or production policy value.
